entities.summary: Bonaventura Berlinghieri was an Italian painter from Lucca, Italy, of the Gothic period. He was son of painter Berlinghiero Berlinghieri and brother of Barone and Marco Berlinghieri. His work is reported to have flourished in between the years AD 1235 and AD 1244.
